sections.chapter_title: Ethernet (ETH): gigabit media access control (GMAC) with DMA controller
sections.section_title: Programming the launch time in time-based scheduling
sections.text_helper: Section 76.9.21 "Programming the launch time in time-based scheduling" in chapter 76 (Ethernet (ETH): gigabit media access control (GMAC) with DMA controller), RM0486 Rev 4, page 4146.
sections.section_content:
The launch time is programmed in the enhanced normal transmit descriptors.
The OSTC and launch time features are mutually exclusive and must not be used together;
in case of a conflict (if OSTC=LTV=1 in MTL configuration), priority is given to OSTC and
the launch time is ignored.
If a context descriptor is received with a valid OSTC value immediately before receiving a
first normal descriptor with LTV bit set, then the LTV is ignored.
